structs.notes: Size 184 is proven by two allocation sites. Placement is proven by the Set* functions and the readers for +16..+44, +80..+88, +96, +104, +112, +120, +144..+168 and +180. The ctor and Create writes disagree with the setters on +92 and +96 (repulsorType vs identityFlags); Create also writes FLT_MAX at +80 after its default, and the record reader names its parameters inconsistently (key 'multiplier' feeds an int that Create stores as identityFlags). The coordinator should decide 92/96 from the record and log semantics. The object's vtable is bfx::RepulsorImpl, so the game-test name bfx::Repulsor maps to the RepulsorImpl object.
